name: @mcv/identity-sdk
description: MCV Continuous Ambient Trust Engine (mcv.id L2). Layered on Clerk Enterprise (L1 Session Ledger), injects an Omni-Trust Score + Civic Clearance tier into JWT custom claims based on ambient biometrics, 4D spatial context, active step-up attestations, and Canadian/US civic identity federation. Augments — never replaces — existing Clerk session management.
